title: ISLA: Ensemble learning and domain adaptation for generalizable acute ischemic stroke lesion segmentation in diffusion MRI with clinical validation
abstract: arXiv:2601.08732v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate segmentation of acute ischemic stroke (AIS) lesions on MRI is essential for clinical decision-making. Deep learning methods offer a promising approach to automating this task. However, they often generalize poorly to unseen clinical sites, and few AIS lesion segmentation methods have been externally validated. In this study, we propose $\mathit{ISLA}$ (Ischemic Stroke Lesion Analyzer), a framework for AIS lesion segmentation built on the design principles of $\mathit{nnU\text{-}Net}$. $\mathit{ISLA}$ combines attention modules, deep supervision, and ensemble learning across different input resolutions, convolutional block types, and loss functions. We also introduce $\mathit{ISLA\text{-}MT}$, a variant that leverages unlabeled target-domain images through semi-supervised learning. translated_title: ISLA：基于集成学习与域适应的可泛化急性缺血性卒中病灶弥散MRI分割方法及临床验证
translated_abstract: 在MRI上对急性缺血性卒中（AIS）病灶进行准确分割对于临床决策至关重要。深度学习方法为实现这一任务的自动化提供了有前景的途径。然而，这些方法在未见过的临床中心往往泛化能力较差，且很少有AIS病灶分割方法经过外部验证。在本研究中，我们提出了ISLA（缺血性卒中病灶分析器），这是一个基于nnU-Net设计原则构建的AIS病灶分割框架。ISLA结合了注意力模块、深度监督，以及在不同输入分辨率、卷积块类型和损失函数上的集成学习。我们还引入了ISLA-MT，这是一个通过半监督学习利用无标签目标域图像的变体。我们在SOOP和ISLES 2022数据集上训练了这两种方法，并在包含253例病例的内部留出验证集上进行评估，同时……
tldr: 该研究提出了基于nnU-Net设计原则的急性缺血性卒中病灶分割框架ISLA，通过集成学习与利用无标签目标域数据的半监督域适应变体ISLA-MT，显著提升了模型在不同临床中心的泛化能力，并完成了临床验证。
en_tdlr: This study proposes ISLA, an nnU-Net-based acute ischemic stroke lesion segmentation framework that leverages ensemble learning and a semi-supervised domain adaptation variant (ISLA-MT) to improve generalization across unseen clinical sites, with clinical validation.
